sources.title: Segment Anything Model (SAM) 3.1 | Meta | Meta - dev.meta.ai
sources.snippet: SAM 3.1 shares its envelope, keys, docs and billing with every other Meta model, so segmentation and video tracking drop smoothly into the pipeline you already have. Reason and generate with Muse Spark, turn speech into text with Muse Voice Transcribe, and detect, segment and track objects with SAM 3.1, all through Meta Model API.
